description: Mealnova global food reference v4. Expanded to high-coverage worldwide recognition with emphasis on India, UK, Europe, China, Thailand, street foods, chaat and chutneys.
quality_note: V4 prioritises recognition breadth and culinary taxonomy. Canonical dishes and practical recognition variants are both included. New nutrition values remain estimated_reference values and must not be treated as clinically or regulatorily validated nutrition. For production calorie tracking, link recognised foods to authoritative nutrition sources and recipe/portion models.
